topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I can't believe it. Mr. Thompson, of all people, with his modest little house and his garden that's just okay? He’s got more money than I can count. I mean, who does that? Just hides it all away like some kind of secret treasure? What if he’s been watching us, seeing how we struggle, and thinking... I don’t even want to think about it. It’s like the ground under me isn’t solid anymore. Everything we knew, it was all just... I don’t know, a show? A lie? I can’t look at him the same way now. Something’s off, and I can’t shake this feeling that we don’t really know anyone around here.
